signal.note: Shapes only — dot, ring, underline, focus outline, caret, selection tint. 2.65:1 on the light ground, so never text.

signal-ink.dark: var(--signal) — aliased; the deep ground already clears contrast
signal-ink.note: Text-only sibling of the accent, 4.92:1 on the light ground. Carries the finale phrase and arrow-link hover.

ground.note: The page. Painted on body and on the fixed wash behind everything.

ink.note: All primary text and every icon stroke. 4.94:1 on the light ground, 5.52:1 over glass.

ink-2.note: Ledes, taglines, notes, footer, pending state. Chosen to clear 4.5:1 rather than sit under it; the dark value runs brighter than a conventional muted tone because it sits over lit blobs.

surface.note: The shadcn --card / --popover / --sidebar slot. Rare in this world; the frosted glass tokens do the work instead.

glass.note: Rest fill for every floating surface. Alpha over the wash — no tonal ramp; the value only means anything with backdrop-filter behind it.

glass-strong.note: Hover fill for cards; rest fill for the scroll ring.

glass-edge.note: The 1px border that declares elevation. This system's entire depth vocabulary.

blob-gloss.note: Radial highlight at 34%/28%, r 46%, clipped to each blob path. A radial gradient on purpose — same look as a blurred spot, no filter pass. Fades to --blob-gloss-out, rgb(255 255 255 / 0), in both themes.

blob-a-1.note: Top-left blob, stop 1 of 3. Gradient axis 8% 0% → 92% 100%.

blob-a-2.note: Top-left blob, stop 2. Also the Stack orbit's Tools ring tone and the third stop of the card gradient edge.

blob-a-3.note: Top-left blob, stop 3. Also the Stack orbit's Languages ring tone.

blob-b-1.note: Top-right blob, stop 1. Also the Stack orbit's Frameworks ring tone and the middle stop of the card gradient edge.

blob-c-1.note: Bottom-left blob, stop 1. Also the first stop of the card gradient edge. Gradient axis 0% 20% → 100% 80%.

display.purpose: The hero headline only, uppercase Unbounded at 700. Carries the outline-and-fill device: .type-outline renders solid ink by default and switches to color: transparent with -webkit-text-stroke: 0.03em at font-weight 400 inside an @supports guard, because Unbounded's heavy weights self-overlap and stroke into visible construction lines. Stroke floors at max(1.1px, 0.03em) under 720px. Drops to clamp(1.25rem, 5.9vw, 1.875rem) / line-height 1.18 under 720px.

headline.purpose: Section titles — WORK, STACK, ABOUT — uppercase. Contact overrides to clamp(2.25rem, 6.5vw, 4.5rem); the menu's section links run clamp(1.75rem, 5vw, 2.5rem).

title.purpose: Project card names, uppercase. The flagship card scales to clamp(1.625rem, 3vw, 2.5rem).

body.purpose: Every paragraph, in Hanken Grotesk at 17px. Measures capped: 46ch hero subline, 42ch section ledes, 40ch card taglines and contact lede, 52ch flagship description, 60ch About (line-height 1.6).

label.purpose: The status line — uppercase, tracked 0.06em. Card notes and the footer use the same size at normal tracking in sentence case.

micro-label.purpose: The orbit's three ring labels — uppercase, tracked 0.1em. A third micro step (600 / 0.75rem / 0.08em, uppercase) carries the menu keycaps and the 'coming soon' pending flag.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The default. Every hover, press, fade, rise and swap. The built-in keywords are too weak.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Symmetric moves. ease-in on its own is banned.

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: The menu sheet's slide, applied through shadcn's Sheet content class.

motion.name: duration-press
motion.purpose: transform on :active { scale(0.97) }, on every pressable element.

motion.name: duration-hover
motion.purpose: Colour, background, border-color and icon nudges.

motion.name: duration-roll-in
motion.purpose: Rolling phrase entrance from translateY(0.7em) + blur(3px). Must match ROLL_MS in RoleRoll.tsx.

motion.name: duration-roll-out
motion.purpose: Rolling phrase exit to translateY(-0.85em). Exits are faster than entrances.

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-in rise for below-the-fold blocks, 24px of travel, staggered 50ms per sibling.

motion.name: drift
motion.purpose: Ambient blob drift, 5-7vmax translate and 7-11deg rotation. Disabled under 720px and under reduced motion.

components.name: Glass Project Card
components.description: The project card: a frosted pane floating over the blob wash. Elevation is declared once, as an edge — this system has no shadows.
components.html:
ScorelyAI

An AI, rubric-based evaluator for DECA reports — high-school competitors use it to get feedback on their written work.

GitHubIn use by DECA competitors

outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-card__link:active { transform: scale(0.97); } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); background: var(--glass-strong); components.name: Gradient-Edge Card
components.description: One card per row carries the world's colour as a 2px gradient border, masked so only the edge shows. Selection is by row/column parity (column === row % 2), never odd index — odd index puts it on every left-column card and reads as a stripe.
components.html:
SantaClaws

OpenClaw agents that find small businesses with a missing or outdated website, then autonomously build them a mockup.
components.css: .ds-card--gradient::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; padding: 2px; background: linear-gradient(120deg, var(--blob-c-1), var(--blob-b-1), var(--blob-a-2)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0); -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0); mask-composite: exclude; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Arrow Link
components.description: The page's primary action shape. Arrow leads on in-page navigation, trails on outbound. Hover nudges the arrow 4px and turns the text the accent's text sibling.
components.html: see my work

components.name: Pending Flag
components.description: A designed unavailable state, not a stopgap. Inert to pointer, keyboard and screen reader alike, and it states its own status inline. Never ship a dead link instead.
components.css: .ds-is-pending { color: var(--ink-2); cursor: default; } .ds-pending-note { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 8px; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-is-pending:hover { color: var(--ink-2); } }

components.name: Badge
components.description: shadcn Badge with the project's tokens as its theme. Outline carries the factual card label; secondary carries the About range chips.

components.name: Status Line
components.description: The availability line under the hero. The coral dot pulses with a scaling ring — transform and opacity only, never an animated box-shadow.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-body-stack); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1; color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-status__dot { position: relative; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--signal); } .ds-status__dot::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--signal); opacity: 0; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-status__dot::after { animation: ds-pulse 2.6s var(--ease-out) infinite; } } @keyframes ds-pulse { from { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.5; } 70%, to { transform: scale(3); opacity: 0; } }

components.name: Contact Email
components.description: The page's single largest link: display face, underlined in the accent. Hover swaps the underline to ink — the text colour never moves.

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: The shell's two controls — theme toggle and dot-grid menu trigger. Transparent at rest, 10% ink on hover, 0.97 on press.

narrative.overview:
A person who is several things at once, introducing himself on a sheet of iridescent film. The ground is a cool lavender-grey with four soft gradient blobs pushed hard into the corners and a real film-grain tile over everything; the centre of the viewport stays calm so wide display capitals can sit on it without fighting colour. The page's whole argument is made twice — once by the words, once by the material: the blobs are three-stop gradients on four different axes, so nothing repeats, and the frosted cards that float over them borrow their colour rather than adding a new one.

Density is low and deliberate. One 1140px column, generous vertical air (80px in, 96px out per section), an 18px grid gap, and long unbroken measures (40–46ch on ledes, 60ch on About). The register is adult and editorial, never bubbly: no sparkles, no candy pastels, no 40px pillow corners, no glossy mascot shapes. Colour lives in the ground; the foreground is ink, glass and one coral.

Two complete themes ship. Dark is not an inverted filter — it is a second token set with a deep indigo ground, a second full set of blob stops mixed brighter, and the blobs held to 62% opacity so body text still survives over them. Every visual decision is expressed as a custom property in app/globals.css, which is the normative source for both.
keyCharacteristics: Iridescent gradient blobs in all four corners, calm ground in the middle
Wide uppercase display capitals with an outline-and-fill contrast device
Frosted glass surfaces whose blur is legibility, not decoration
Exactly one accent colour, split into a shape token and a text token
A real 128px grain raster, not an SVG filter
Flat by construction: edges and blur convey depth, never shadows

rules.name: The Two Corals Rule
rules.body: --signal draws shapes; --signal-ink writes words. Never swap them. The light accent fails text contrast (2.65:1) and the dark ground makes a second value unnecessary, which is exactly why the split is a token and not a judgement call.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Coral appears in six places and no more: the finale phrase, the status dot and its pulse, the email underline, the scroll-ring fill, the focus outline, and the caret/selection tint. Anything else that wants colour takes it from the blob range instead.

rules.name: The Calm Centre Rule
rules.body: Iridescence lives in the four corners at negative offsets; the middle band of every viewport stays ground. Type is never composited over a gradient peak, which is what lets 4.9:1 ink hold on a coloured page.

rules.name: The Ground-Only Iridescence Rule
rules.body: Blob colours are for the wash, the card gradient edge, and the orbit ring tones. They never become body text, a card background, or a button fill.

rules.name: The Outline-Lead Rule
rules.body: Only the lead-in words are outlined — "HEY, I'M" and the standalone "I'M". The subject is always filled. Outline is a contrast device between the greeting and the person, never a decoration applied to a whole heading.

rules.name: The Never-Stroke-Bold Rule
rules.body: Outlined type runs at weight 400 inside the @supports guard, and the solid fallback runs at 700. Raising the outline weight to match the fill re-introduces the self-overlap artefacts the guard exists to avoid.

rules.name: The Uppercase Display Rule
rules.body: h1, h2 and h3 are uppercase Unbounded at 700 with positive tracking (0.015em base). Body copy is never uppercase; only the three micro-label steps are, and they always carry ≥0.06em tracking to stay legible.

rules.name: The 1140 Rule
rules.body: Content lives in a 1140px column with a 24px gutter (20px under 760px). The only full-bleed layers are the fixed wash and the fixed header.

rules.name: The Fixed-Ground Rule
rules.body: The wash is position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: -1, aria-hidden, and pointer-events: none. It scrolls with nothing and intercepts nothing.

rules.name: The Portrait-vmax Rule
rules.body: Blobs are sized in vmax on desktop (40–46vmax) but in vw under 720px (76–84vw), because on a phone vmax is the viewport height — which makes the blobs full-bleed and swallows the body copy.

rules.name: The Edge-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface declares its elevation once, as an edge. A 1px border under a soft drop shadow is the ghost-card look this world refuses.

rules.name: The Blur-Is-Legibility Rule
rules.body: Any surface that floats over the wash must carry backdrop-filter: blur() saturate(). The blur is what keeps text readable over a saturated blob; it is a functional requirement, not a finish.

rules.name: The Held-Back-Blob Rule
rules.body: In dark, .wash__blob runs at opacity: 0.62. The blobs are far brighter than the deep indigo ground, and body text has to survive over them.

rules.name: The One Radius Family Rule
rules.body: 22px card, 999px pill, 1rem control, 4px focus. A new value needs a new reason.

rules.name: The Drawn-Not-Set Rule
rules.body: Every mark on this page is authored SVG in currentColor — the monogram, the dot grid, the arrows, the sun and moon, the seven project marks. No icon fonts, no glyph characters standing in for icons, no raster illustration.

dos: Do put every new colour through the token layer in app/globals.css, and define it in both :root and .dark. A value that only exists in one theme is a bug.
Do use --signal for marks and --signal-ink for text (The Two Corals Rule).
Do give any surface that floats over the wash a backdrop-filter: blur() saturate() and a 1px --glass-edge border.
Do keep new sections inside .section (1140px / 24px gutter / 80px–96px vertical) and give them an id plus aria-labelledby, so the menu and the 1/2/3/4 shortcuts can reach them.
Do wrap below-the-fold content in <Reveal> and stagger siblings at 50ms.
Do author new icons as SVG in currentColor at the established stroke weights (2.25 for UI arrows, 2.5 for project marks), round caps and joins.
Do put every hover rule behind @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) and give every pressable a :active { scale(0.97) }.
Do regenerate the grain with node scripts/make-grain.mjs public/textures/grain.png rather than hand-editing the PNG; the seed is the provenance.
Do cap measures — 40–46ch for ledes and taglines, 60ch for long-form body.
Do keep the outline device on lead-in words only, at weight 400 inside the @supports guard.
donts: Don't add a box-shadow. This system has none; elevation is an edge over blur (The Edge-Not-Shadow Rule).
Don't paint blob colours onto text, card fills or buttons. They are ground, gradient edge and orbit tone only.
Don't stroke display type at 700 — Unbounded's heavy contours self-overlap and the stroke exposes the construction lines.
Don't size the blobs in vmax below 720px; portrait vmax is the viewport height and the blobs swallow the copy.
Don't animate anything interruptible with a keyframe. Use a transition so it can retarget mid-flight.
Don't let a stagger exceed 80ms per step, or an exit run longer than its entrance.
Don't animate a keyboard-initiated scroll, and don't put scroll-behavior: smooth outside the reduced-motion guard.
Don't rotate the Stack orbit or add a fourth continuous ambient motion; two (the roll, the blob drift) is the budget.
Don't collapse the orbit into a stacked list on mobile — it scrolls instead.
Don't ship a dead link. An unavailable action takes the designed pending state (.is-pending plus a .pending-note pill), inert to pointer, keyboard and screen reader.
Don't introduce a fifth radius, a second accent, or a new display face.
Don't override shadcn's --accent expecting the page accent; that slot belongs to shadcn, ours is --signal.
